newsitem.title: USA: TALKING POINT-Dean Witter, M. Stanley.
newsitem.headline: TALKING POINT-Dean Witter, M. Stanley.

text.p: The marriage of blue-blood banker Morgan Stanley Group Inc and everyman-broker Dean Witter Discover & Co will instantly create a Wall Street behemoth, but its success hinges on the swift closure of a vast cultural gap.
While news of the proposed $10.2 billion stock-swap merger announced early Wednesday shocked Wall Street, analysts and investors were generally supportive of the deal.
"I think it makes a lot of sense," said Robert Stovall of Stovall/Twenty-First Advisers, who worked for Dean Witter and a predecesor firm for 16 years.

"I think Dean Witter would benefit from the risk management skills of Morgan Stanley," he said, while Morgan Stanley will gain in selling the stock and debt issues managed by the firm through Dean Witter's vast retail network.
As the surprise over the unlikely pairing faded, the deal gathered investor support, and the shares of both rose sharply to all-time highs, despite a broad decline in U.S. equities.
